integrity: Original source propagators and stationary Bessel densities are credited; the proposed result is the model-specific squared-Bessel conjugacy, likelihood-ratio order, two-time fourth-radius law and three-parameter inversion. Computational checks supplement the analytical proof. Priority remains contingent on independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact singular radial diffusivity, canonical conservative/no-flux origin, state-independent Poisson resets, stationary population moments. Non-Poisson reset clocks, nonzero reset locations, regularization at the origin, and fractional memory require new analysis. Finite-sample estimator efficiency and uncertainty are not claimed.
title: Stationary and temporal fingerprints for resetting in singular planar diffusion
